events.assessment: The flagged transaction 3450629 is part of a rapid sequence of three transactions totaling approximately $300 within a 70-minute window on 2016-11-11. While the cardholder has a history of making individual transactions of around $100, this sudden burst combined with the use of a hidden proxy on the final transaction suggests potential card abuse or account takeover.
key_points: A rapid burst of three transactions (3450436, 3450503, and 3450629) occurred on 2016-11-11, all clustered around the $100 threshold.
The flagged transaction 3450629 is the only one in the sequence that utilized a hidden IP proxy, which likely triggered the elevated risk score of 0.57.
Historical recurring matches show a pattern of ~$100 transactions dating back to July 2016, but they are typically spaced days or weeks apart rather than minutes.
